doubts: Out and back: the page gives the Rangitoto Summit Track as 2 hr / 7 km return, and says to return to the wharf the same way, so the main way is out and back, with the Crater Rim Track loop and the Lava Caves Track recorded as side trips. Wilson's Park Track is the page's own alternative route to Summit Lookout, with its own heading, time and distance, so it is recorded as W2, one way from its turnoff (40 min from the wharf) to Summit Lookout; its return is not described. Rangitoto Wharf and Summit Lookout have no feature or name entry, so their refs are null. The summit/tihi is matched to the peak entry Rangitoto (T6); this is a judgement. The Lava Caves Track turnoff is 45 min from the wharf and 15 min from the summit, but the turnoff itself is not named, so its from is null. The historic Scouts bach near the start is not recorded as a via, since the text mentions it only as a landmark near the start. The page's longer walks link (L1) is recorded as an access point to Summit Lookout, not as a not-on-route place. The time and distance for the main way are DOC's summary (2 hr return; 7 km return via same track).
